After the closing quote only whitespace or a `# comment` is allowed. Unquoted values still end at the first `#`. I added `TestParseValueQuoting` in `parser_test.go` covering all four rules from the brief.

One behaviour I added that you didn't ask for: text after the closing quote that isn't a comment now returns "unexpected text after quoted value".

The repro check prints `Issue #42: retry` and `go test ./...` passes. I recorded `observed` for `repro`, `tested` for `regression`, and `tested` for `spec`. `repro` and `spec` still need the independent verifier.
